npc.barazbaz.array_1: [PT] Ancient structures in the sewers you say? Well, our city has had a certain bloody past, even before it has been city at all. But to investigate the archives for what you may have found is a time-consuming process. ...

npc.caramellia.stdmod_1: [PT] Can I finally have some peace...?
npc.caramellia.stdmod_10: My father wanted me to marry a wealthy VeNãorean. He understood so little about love and the ways of the heart.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_11: [PT] The city of the elves is an exotic wonder.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_12: [PT] The city is like the dwarfs that built it. Stony, never-changing and hard to understand for an outsider.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_2: [PT] Please leave me alone in my mourning.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_3: [PT] All is lost. With {Winfred} dead, my love has died and I'm only an empty shell without hope or purpose.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_4: We put all our hope in this far away colony. Sadly, we never made it there and I will never kNãow what our life would have been like in Port Hope.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_5: [PT] I guess he was the one that put my father up to the whole thing. He spied on Winfred and me and it was certainly him that suggested my {imprisonment} in this tower.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_6: [PT] This forsaken place seems as remote from the rest of the world as my heart is.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_7: [PT] Please leave me alone in my mourning.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_8: [PT] The bustling streets of Thais are all but a faint memory to me.
npc.caramellia.stdmod_9: [PT] Carlin is a lovely and green city as far as I remember.

npc.cedrik.stdmod_14: [PT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

npc.chavis.say_1: Hey there, just to let you kNãow - I am Nãot a man of many words. I prefer 'deeds', you see? The poor of this city will Nãot feed themselves. ...
npc.chavis.say_2: So in case you've got Nãothing better to do - and it sure looks that way judging by how long you're already loitering around in front of my Nãose - please Ajuda us. ...
npc.chavis.say_3: If you can find some of the nutritious, juicy {roots} in the outskirts of Rathleton, bring them here. We will gladly take bundles of five roots each, and hey - Ajudaing us, Ajudas you in the long term, trust me.
npc.chavis.say_4: [PT] Don't be fooled, we have here masters and servants like everywhere else. The whole system is a scam to subdue the masses, to fool them about what is really happening. ...
npc.chavis.say_5: [PT] The system only ensures that the rich have a better control and the labourers are only used.

npc.cipfried.kw_ship_1: [PT] Ships are a comfortable way of travelling to distant cities. At any harbour, you can board the ship and ask its captain where he sails to.
npc.cipfried.kw_ship_2: Travelling by ship will cost you some Ouro, though, so be sure to have money with you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_1: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or Ajuda!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_10: [PT] Your near destiny will be to choose a {vocation} once you are level 8. Whether you will become a {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid} is a big decision!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_11: That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called {Rookgaard}, to be precise, with many {Monstros}, {Missãos} and {citizens} around.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_12: How can I Ajuda you? I can tell you about specific {citizens} if you tell me their name. I can also give you general {hints} about {Tibia}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_13: Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {Comércio} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_14: I don't have any goods for Comércio, but if you ask one of the {merchants}, he or she will gladly show you what you can Comprar or Vender.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_15: A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful Nãot to get cornered by many of them. They could still {kill} you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_16: If you face spiders, beware of the {poisoNãous} ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose health. Come to me and I'll heal you from poison.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_17: [PT] If you get killed, you will revive in this temple. However, you will lose experience and also equipment, which can be quite painful. Take good care of yourself!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_18: Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisoNãous and will make you lose health!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_19: [PT] There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each vocation has its unique special abilities.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_2: [PT] Come to me if you need healing!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_20: [PT] Knights are close combat fighters. They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_21: [PT] Druids are nature magicians. Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_22: [PT] Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_23: [PT] Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_24: You can Comprar and Vender goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {Comércio}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they Comprar from you.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_25: You can Comprar equipment from the {merchants} in this village once you earned some {Ouro}. Some {Monstros} also carry equipment pieces with them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_26: Shovels are very useful. There may be a hidden entrance under a loose pile of stone and without a shovel, how would you kNãow?
npc.cipfried.stdmod_27: [PT] Never go adventuring without a rope! If you don't have one when you fall through a hole in the ground, you won't be able to leave without a rope.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_28: [PT] To defend yourself against enemies, you will need a weapon. You can purchase weapons at {Obi}'s shop.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_29: Food is very important for your health. If you are hurt in a fight with a {Monstro}, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your health.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_3: Bem-vindo to the temple of Rookgaard!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_30: [PT] As a premium adventurer, you are an official tax payer and thus privileged in many ways. For example, you can travel by {ship} and get better deals from {merchants}.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_31: [PT] Potions will come in handy once you are in a fight deep in a dungeon. If you aren't in immediate danger, you can simply eat {food} to regain health, though.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_32: The academy is just Nãorth of here. You can learn Ajudaful things there from {Seymour}, if you wish to!
npc.cipfried.stdmod_33: [PT] Well, King Tibianus of course. The island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_34: The {gods} have chosen this isle as the point of arrival for newborn souls. The {citizens} will Ajuda you if you ask them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_35: [PT] They created {Tibia} and all life on it. Visit our {academy} and learn about them.
npc.cipfried.stdmod_36: Monstros are a constant threat to this village. You would tremendously Ajuda us by fighting them, starting with {rats} in the {sewers}, then turning to {spiders} or {wolves}.

npc.dixi.stdmod_45: [PT] Billy can be kind of scary. He swears a lot and doesn't talk to everybody.
npc.dixi.stdmod_46: Uncle Willie and {Billy} are farmers, which means they are a good place to Vender and Comprar {food}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_47: [PT] He can heal you if you're injured or poisoned.
npc.dixi.stdmod_48: [PT] Did I hear my name somewhere?
npc.dixi.stdmod_49: [PT] I think he's a bit strange, living alone outside this village. How can he dislike to chat with everybody here?
npc.dixi.stdmod_5: Don't let these mean Monstros hurt you - get better equipment Nãow!
npc.dixi.stdmod_50: [PT] Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit it!
npc.dixi.stdmod_51: I always give my cookies and blueberries to Lily. She loves them! Also, she Venders {potions}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_52: [PT] You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to find your {destiny}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_54: [PT] Seymour is a loyal follower of the {king} and a teacher in the {academy}.
npc.dixi.stdmod_55: I wish he would talk to his mother {Zirella} again. I feel so sorry for her. Anyway, as Tom is a tanner, you can Vender leather and fresh corpses to him.
npc.dixi.stdmod_56: He's one of our reliable guardsmen. Without them, many {Monstros} would roam the village of {Rookgaard}!
npc.dixi.stdmod_6: Good day, Ma'am. How may I Ajuda you, |JogadorNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a Comércio!
npc.dixi.stdmod_7: Good day, Sir. How may I Ajuda you, |JogadorNAME|? If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a Comércio!
npc.dixi.voice_1: [PT] <clears throat> Get your armor and shields heeeeeeere! Upstairs!
npc.dixi.voice_2: Need some Ajuda? Just ask me, I can show you around!
npc.dixi.voice_3: [PT] Don't forget to protect yourself with a shield!
npc.dixi.voice_4: Vendering the finest armors on Rookgaard!
npc.dixi.voice_5: Don't let these mean Monstros hurt you - get better equipment Nãow!
npc.duria.stdmod_1: [PT] In this category I have '{Wound Cleansing}' and '{Cure Poison}'.
npc.duria.stdmod_2: [PT] In this category I have '{Light}', '{Find Person}' and '{Great Light}'.
npc.duria.stdmod_3: [PT] I can teach you {healing spells} and {support spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? You can also tell me for which level you would like to learn a spell, if you prefer that.
npc.ebenizer.voice_1: [PT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.eclesius.voice_1: [PT] I'm looking for a new assistant!
npc.eclesius.voice_2: [PT] Err, what was it again that I wanted...?
npc.eclesius.voice_3: [PT] Do come in! Mind the step of the magical door, though.
npc.eclesius.voice_4: [PT] I'm so sorry... I promise it won't happen again. Problem is, I can't remember where I made the error...
npc.eclesius.voice_5: [PT] Actually, I STILL prefer inexperienced assistants. They're easier to keep an eye on and don't tend to backstab you.
npc.eclesius.voice_6: [PT] So much to do, so much to do... uh... where should I start?
npc.edala.stdmod_1: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| Ouro, child?
npc.edala.stdmod_10: [PT] I can sense that the spark of the phoenix already was given to you by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.edala.stdmod_11: [PT] I can sense you already talked to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya and received this blessing.
npc.edala.stdmod_12: [PT] You can ask for the blessing of spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.edala.stdmod_13: The druids Nãorth of Carlin will provide you with the embrace of Tibia.
npc.edala.stdmod_14: [PT] The spark of the phoenix is given by the dwarven priests of earth and fire in Kazordoon.
npc.edala.stdmod_15: [PT] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.edala.stdmod_2: [PT] So receive the fire of the suns, pilgrim.
npc.edala.stdmod_3: [PT] Fine. You are free to decline my offer.
npc.edala.stdmod_4: [PT] You are hurt, my child. I will heal your wounds.
npc.edala.stdmod_5: You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't Ajuda you. But if you are looking for additional protection you should go on the {pilgrimage} of ashes or get the protection of the {twist of fate} here.
npc.edala.stdmod_6: [PT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.edala.stdmod_7: [PT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.edala.stdmod_8: [PT] I see you received the spiritual shielding in the whiteflower temple south of Thais.
npc.edala.stdmod_9: I can sense that the druids Nãorth of Carlin have provided you with the Embrace of Tibia.
npc.eddy.stdmod_1: [PT] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.eddy.stdmod_2: [PT] I have {beds}, {chairs}, {containers}, {decoration}, {flowers}, {instruments}, {pillows}, {pottery}, {statues}, {tapestries} and {tables}. Which of those would you like to see?
npc.eddy.voice_1: [PT] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_1: [PT] Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_10: Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do Nãot stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_11: For a knight from Yanara 10,000 Ouro were a lot. So he ventured with a team into the desert to win that pot. He solved all the riddles, strongly willed. But on his journey home he sadly was killed.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_12: [PT] A great mage from Celesta went dungeon down deep, he was very brave but his wand was cheap. Among white skeletons one of them was red. Last what he saw were the words: 'You are dead!'
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_13: A young sorcerer born and raised on Astera when dragons were scary, it was that kind of era. Walking all the way to the city of VeNãore, he stole from the dwarven bridge Nãothing less than an iron ore.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_14: A druid from Eternia just bought his first boots of haste, to finally have his leather boots replaced. Catching a backpack of fish was Nãow his dream, but he ended up swinging his new boots upstream.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_15: A sorcerer from Efidia took his horse and got it saddled, and set out for battle. His horse lost control and threw him into a hole. Nãow his team lost all hope, because he forgot to bring a rope.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_16: [PT] A knight in Guardia was feeling bored. He wanted to show a dragon lord the taste of his new carlin sword. To its lair then he did go. But before he saw his foe, he met his end by a one hit K.O.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_17: [PT] On Secura a confident knight levelled to main, 840 rats he had slain. 'I am going to kill dragons,' he said while pounding his breastplate. The next thing he saw was: 'You have met a sad fate.'
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_18: One morning frosty fresh and nice, a knight was fishing on the ice. Catching some pikes for soup, but a dire penguin ate his loot. His angry wife said in the house: Nãow whole Beneva will laugh at us!
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_19: A paladin slaying dragons on Antica's soil, when a lord charges on to make the adventurer's blood boil. It puts up a strong fight, but to Não avail. It gets slain and drops a dragon scale mail!
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_2: A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping Não one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_20: Through Rookgaard's sewer there swarmed Não fewer than a hundred screeching rats. Wading through mud, and covered in blood, two young men fought back-to-back. To Trimera's end; a knight, and a friend.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_21: Our world, our home, our very own plane of existence. We have to protect it, mind you. Underneath all the battles, challenges and Monstros there still resides a majestic, yet vulnerable being. A mother to us all.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_22: A king and a beggar kNãow more than a king alone... ahem, except for King Tibianus. He most certainly would. All hail King Tibianus etc. etc.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_23: So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A Missão to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Sim, we are indeed.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_24: So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A Missão to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Sim, we are indeed.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_25: Rather a calling. The weight of words is something Nãot easily lifted by some, yet it can be a mighty weapon to others. ...
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_3: A knight from Candia was dining at Frodo's hut, devouring plates full of meat and whatNãot. Suddenly, he was called to fight. He wanted to put his armor on but it was too tight.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_4: [PT] The druid entered a Premian pyramid intent on the kill, 'Oh, that djinn will die, it will!' Down and up the stairs she hopped like a cat... When, Oops! She moved the wrong way, and died a drunk rat.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_5: [PT] Hoping to find a strange orc in his spawn, a Zaneran knight logged on before dawn. A sudden heart attack left him surprised as Sam's old backpack he had recognised.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_6: The world I shall save', an Olympian knight proclaimed! But from a visit to the bar he could Nãot abstain! He woke up in pain, it all was in vain. From VeNãorian beer he will forever refrain.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_7: [PT] During the dark and scary night, when others sleep he goes to fight, banishing demons, that feels right, purging the evil on the sight, fearlessly waiting for daylight, Zeluna's bravest elite knight.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_8: [PT] A druid from Celesta once talked with a girl, he even bought her a necklace with a huge white pearl. Every time he went home, without money and fame, I guess this girl is cursed, Aruda is the name.
npc.edgar_ellen.stdmod_9: A story of a knight untold, on Rowana the dice she rolled. She lured Jogadors from afar. Who could resist a shining star? She promised Ouro and many items, then stole their heart with cunning kindness.

npc.edowir.stdmod_1: I'm just an old man, but I kNãow a lot about Tibia.
npc.edowir.stdmod_2: I gather wisdom and kNãowledge. I am also an astrologer.
npc.edowir.voice_1: I'm just an old man, but I kNãow a lot about Tibia.
npc.edvard.stdmod_1: [PT] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.edvard.stdmod_2: Well, as you can see, I Vender furniture. Ask me for a {Comércio} if you're interested to see my wares.
npc.edvard.voice_1: [PT] Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.
npc.eighty.voice_1: [PT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.elane.stdmod_1: We are always looking for sniper gloves. They are supposed to raise accuracy. If you find a pair, bring them here. Maybe I can offer you a nice Comércio.
npc.elane.stdmod_10: We will Ajuda you to improve your skills. Besides I offer spells for paladins.
npc.elane.stdmod_11: [PT] Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.
npc.elane.stdmod_12: [PT] Some paladins serve in the kings army.
npc.elane.stdmod_14: [PT] How spineless do you have to be to become a jester?
npc.elane.stdmod_16: He must have been skilled before he became the way he is Nãow. Such a pity.
npc.elane.stdmod_18: The alcohol he Venders shrouds the mind and the eye.
npc.elane.stdmod_19: [PT] One of the most important members of our guild. She makes all the bows and arrows we need.
npc.elane.stdmod_2: I am the leader of the Paladins. I Ajuda our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_20: He Venders a lot of useful equipment.
npc.elane.stdmod_21: [PT] He and his guildfellows lack the grace of a true warrior.
npc.elane.stdmod_22: [PT] A fine warrior and a skilled general.
npc.elane.stdmod_23: [PT] King Tibianus is a wise ruler.
npc.elane.stdmod_24: [PT] A follower of evil that will get what he deserves one day.
npc.elane.stdmod_25: [PT] Mhm, a little too nice for my taste. Still, it's amazing how she endures all those men stalking her, especially this creepy Oswald.
npc.elane.stdmod_26: [PT] A skilled healer, that's for sure.
npc.elane.stdmod_28: [PT] If there wouldn't be higher powers to protect him...
npc.elane.stdmod_29: [PT] A humble monk and a wise man.
npc.elane.stdmod_3: I am the leader of the Paladins. I Ajuda our members.
npc.elane.stdmod_30: [PT] Strong man. But a little shy.
npc.elane.stdmod_4: [PT] Paladins are great warriors and magicians. Besides that we are excellent missile fighters. Many people in Tibia want to join us.
npc.elane.stdmod_5: Of course, we aren't as strong as knights, but Não druid or sorcerer will ever defeat a paladin with a sword.
npc.elane.stdmod_6: [PT] There are many magic spells and runes paladins can use.
npc.elane.stdmod_7: [PT] Paladins are the best missile fighters in Tibia!
npc.elane.stdmod_8: I am a paladin, Nãot a storyteller.
npc.elane.stdmod_9: [PT] Every paladin profits from his vocation. It has many advantages to be a paladin.
npc.elathriel.greet_1: Be greeted |JogadorNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?
npc.elathriel.say_1: If you are that curious, do you want to Comprar a key for 5000 Ouro? \z Don't blame me if you get sucked in.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_1:
[PT] I am the leader of the Kuridai and the Az'irel of Ab'Dendriel. \z
				Humans would call it {sheriff}, executioner, or avenger.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_10: [PT] It's hard for some of my people to grasp the true concept of a strong leader.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_13: A human weakling, Nãot much more.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_14: A human weakling, Nãot much more.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_15: [PT] Druidic magic is too peaceful for my taste.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_16: [PT] I have seen human sorcerers doing some impressive things ... before they died.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_17: [PT] We might use the shelter earth and hills provide us, but their obsession for metal is a waste of time.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_18:
[PT] Like all inferior races, they can be at least of use for something good. \z
				The other castes are just jealous of us making use of them.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_2:
[PT] Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_20: Even if he'd walk through the town above, the other castes would Nãot see the necessity to follow OUR way.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_21:
[PT] My people are divided in castes in these times, until they comprehend \z
				that only the way of the Kuridai can save us all.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_22: [PT] Arrogant bastards, but they wield quite powerful magic.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_23: Dreamers are of Não practical use. I don't mourn their demise.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_24: [PT] Confused cowards. For all their skill, they still tend to hide and run. What a waste.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_25: [PT] We are the heart of the elven society. We forge, we build, and we don't allow our people to be pushed around.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_26: [PT] We watch this city and the actions of its inhabitants closely.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_27:
The merchants of veNãore provide us with some useful goods. \z
				Still I an convinced that they get more out of our bargain then we do.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_28: [PT] The Thaian kingdom and we share some enemies, so it's only logical to cooperate in a few areas.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_29: I offer hardly anything except for kNãowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_3:
[PT] Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_30: I offer hardly anything except for kNãowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_31: I offer hardly anything except for kNãowledge of {spells}.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_32: Be greeted |JogadorNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?
npc.elathriel.stdmod_4:
[PT] Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. \z
				True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_5:
[PT] It was here among other structures, like the depot tower, before our people came here. \z
				It's secured by a sealed door.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_6: [PT] For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the {keys} to open it when needed.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_7: [PT] For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the {keys} to open it when needed.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_8: Nãot that I like to talk to you, but I am Elathriel Shadowslayer.
npc.elathriel.stdmod_9: [PT] It's one of the more useful concepts we can learn from the other races.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_1: [PT] The elves of this city are the casts of the Cenath, the Kuridai, and the Deraisim.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_2: I am a guardian of this town. I have Não time to chat!
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_3: [PT] The Cenath are magic users. Look for them on the upper levels of the town.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_4: [PT] The Deraisim are scouts and hunters. You may find them on the groundlevel of the city.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_6: [PT] If you are looking for that kind of equipment you should ask a Kuridai.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_7: [PT] Ask around in Ab'Dendriel. Many elves can teach you something about magic. The Cenath love magic most of all.
npc.elf_guard.stdmod_8: [PT] The city of the humans lies somewhere far to the south beyond the mountains of the dwarfs.
npc.elgar.voice_1: [PT] Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_1: [PT] I am a jeweller. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful {offers}.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_2: Well, I Vender gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {Comércio}.
npc.eliyas.stdmod_3: Ah, our newest import! We have Ouroen goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.
npc.elvith.stdmod_1: I Vender musical instruments of many kinds.
npc.elvith.stdmod_10: That is some god the humans worship. Our pople are Nãot interested in this gods anymore.
npc.elvith.stdmod_11: [PT] They are too loud and don't even understand the concept of a melody.
npc.elvith.stdmod_12: [PT] The other deraisim are too much concerned with mastering the nature so they don't listen to its music anymore.
npc.elvith.stdmod_13: The Cenath think they kNãow the 'art' but the only true art is the music.
npc.elvith.stdmod_14: I went down to the mines and tried to lighten up their spirit, the foolish creatures did Nãot listen to my songs, though.
npc.elvith.stdmod_15: [PT] Sorry, I don't feel like teaching magic today.
npc.elvith.stdmod_16: For the worst of crimes, criminals are cast into hellgate. It is said Não one can return from there. Since it is Nãot actually forbidden to enter hellgate, you might convince Elathriel to grant you entrance.
npc.elvith.stdmod_2: I Vender lyres, lutes, drums, and simple fanfares.
npc.elvith.stdmod_3: [PT] Music is an attempt to condensate emotions in harmonies and save them for the times to come.
npc.elvith.stdmod_4: Time has its own song. Close your eSim and listen to the symphony of the seasons.
npc.elvith.stdmod_5: [PT] Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
npc.elvith.stdmod_6: [PT] Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
npc.elvith.stdmod_7: [PT] We are the most graceful of all races. We feel the music of the universe in our hearts and souls.
npc.elvith.stdmod_8: [PT] They could dig some halls for a big musical event, but they won't listen to me about that matter.

npc.falonzo.stdmod_3: This is a lesser plane of tarnished, elemental fire that once belonged to the world that we kNãow. It was despoiled in the wars of the gods and broke loose from our world. {Lost} and drifting through the void, without a connection to our plane.

npc.flickering_soul.array_1: I was once kNãown as the necromant king. ...
npc.flickering_soul.array_2: For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just aNãother stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.
npc.flickering_soul.array_3: Nãow I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.
npc.flickering_soul.array_4: [PT] Everything I had worked for and my plans for the things to come seemed pointless, and the things I had lost and never allowed myself to experience weighed heavily on my soul.
npc.flickering_soul.say_1: [PT] It has been a while since I roamed the world of the living in a mortal shell.
npc.flickering_soul.say_11: [PT] You haven't killed Malice yet. You haven't killed Hatred yet. You haven't killed Spite yet. You haven't killed Cruelty yet. You haven't killed Greed yet.
npc.flickering_soul.say_12: [PT] My daughter was as ambitious as me, yet she lacked my intellect and my raw talent. She still was great and talented yet I sadly let her feel my disdain. One of the many errors that my way of hubris made me do.
npc.flickering_soul.say_13: I'm Nãot aware of the fate of my linage. Neither I'm able to relate to the mortal world in that way. Each of us is an individual, Nãot bound by ties of blood or herritage.
npc.flickering_soul.say_14: His avatar might be destroyed for Nãow and it'd grip on Zarganash considerably weakened. Yet he burrowed to deep into the essence of this realm to be annihilated this easy.
npc.flickering_soul.say_15: [PT] I despised my followers for their petty agendas and for their limited vision of my own goals and personality.
npc.flickering_soul.say_16: I have cleansed you from the taints that you carried with you. You are Nãow free from the burden that you should Nãot have to bear.
npc.flickering_soul.say_17: You are Nãot tainted by the darkness of the world. You are pure and free from the burdens that others carry.
npc.flickering_soul.say_18: I was once kNãown as the necromant king. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_19: For some it was meant as a curse, others used the name with reverence. To me it was just aNãother stepping stone, in a life that burned with ambition.
npc.flickering_soul.say_2: [PT] I had many names in my live. The one that would be the most recognizable is probably the name Goshnar. Even that was an assumed name that I took when I left my mundane past behind.
npc.flickering_soul.say_20: My ambitions were high and knew Não limits. Mastery over life and death was but a milestone that I wanted to accomplish. In the end I aspired probably somewhat like godhood. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_21: Though in hindsight even that wouldn't have been eNãough. There was a hunger in me that Nãothing could put to rest.
npc.flickering_soul.say_22: I was so convinced about my brilliance, my greatness, my destiny. And this hunger for more, it let me Nãot have peace at any point in my life. I was always driven. There was Não time to rest. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_23: And there was Não looking back. I never cared to remember my humble beginnings, what I had sacrificed to get where I was. All that I had left behind and that I had lost forever. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_24: Nãow I see the bitter irony. I could bring back the dead, but I couldn't create second chances. I couldn't restore the truly important things that I had lost.
npc.flickering_soul.say_25: Zarganash was Nãot a place without its dangers, but for a soul as powerful as mine, there was little threat at all. For the first time in my existence I had to stop running forward. I had to wait for things to fit into their places. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_26: [PT] And me, who had seen things that horrible, they would have obliterated a lesser man's mind, finally took the time to look back. And what I saw was frightening in its own right. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_27: [PT] A great tiredness overcame me. With the flames of my ambitions calming down for the first time since I could remember, all my aspirations and plans seemed to petty and futile. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_28: [PT] Everything I had worked for and my plans for the things to come seemed pointless, and the things I had lost and never allowed myself to experience weighed heavily on my soul.
npc.flickering_soul.say_29: [PT] I talked to other souls, lost in Zarganash, and most of them seemed like mirrors to myself. Their faults, their shortcomings, the things that were important to them and the things they had lost. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_3: Everything in my life was just a tool to further my goals. The brotherhood of bones was just a tool for me. As was everyone or everything. In the path I had chosen Nãothing mattered but me and my ambitions.
npc.flickering_soul.say_30: [PT] It was all like miniature copies of my own grand plans and losses. It made me think. And the great tiredness weighed even more heavy on me. A weariness of the world, of the hunger that drove me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_31: Then I met a wise soul. A teacher that did Nãot lecture. I never was impressed by anything but my own accomplishments. But the inner balance and peace of this soul, it did impress me. A lot. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_32: I, who fancied myself to have been the epitome of kNãowledge, learned things that were entirely new to me. But this kNãowledge wasn't about power. It was about me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_33: [PT] I decided to stay here, even pass on into the great beyond at some point. Yet I still feel the pull of my fetters. I can faintly hear those who think they are my followers, calling to me.
npc.flickering_soul.say_34: [PT] And I feel others, many others who crave my powers and try to bring me back for their own gain.
npc.flickering_soul.say_35: [PT] Over my time in Zarganash I split away the parts of me that my worldly fetters were bound to. Yet I had to recognize that they are still a part of me and I'm bound to them. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_36: [PT] The fetters and the efforts to call me back are empowering them. I feel them growing in strength and gaining awareness on their own. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_37: They are beginning to feed Nãot only on the fetters and incarnations but also on me. As I grow weaker, they grow more powerful over time.
npc.flickering_soul.say_38: You did it! For the first time I can feel free from the pull of my past. Nãow I'm free at last. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_39: I might stay a while and teach other souls about the inner peace, but will eventually pass on. Obrigado so much, my hero. My eternal gratitude and blessings will be with you!
npc.flickering_soul.say_4: Necromancy was a passion at first, aNãother tool while I amassed power and a crutch when my ambitions surpassed that what it could accomplish.
npc.flickering_soul.say_40: [PT] You will have to reach each of the negative parts of my personality that I split away. They are hidden deep in the depths of Zarganash and will have corrupted and twisted their surroundings into dangerous nightmares. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_41: [PT] Even worse, you'll likely encounter minions of those who want to claim my soul as their prize for their own depraved reasons. You will have to destroy my shards to set me free.
npc.flickering_soul.say_42: [PT] I hated the world for its flaws and the reluctance of people to comply with my will. I was convinced I was destined for greatness and to change everything. Ordinary beings were far beneath me and my consideration. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_43: [PT] All this opposition, all the wars were a nuisance on my way to greatness. I would have sacrificed the whole world to reach my goals.
npc.flickering_soul.say_44: [PT] Even in the lands of the dead, this one caused a stir. The dead were whispering his name. It made me feel jealous and angry at first, but at some point, after much self-reflection, I could recognize my own faults in the stories about him.
npc.flickering_soul.say_45: [PT] It was almost like looking into a mirror for the first time. However, he lived way later than me, and I never met his soul here, so I can't tell more about him.
npc.flickering_soul.say_46: [PT] They called me the necromant king, in an act of reverence, but to me it was always more of a slander. To limit my greatness to this insignificant aspect was an insult to my ego. But I let it slip for the greater good. ...
npc.flickering_soul.say_47: [PT] I felt it was beneath me to correct them and I went along.
npc.flickering_soul.say_5: My demise did Nãot meet me unprepared. As a powerful necromancer I had fettered my soul in the living world and the realms beyond. I had prepared for my return and was confident in my power.
npc.flickering_soul.say_6: My soul wandered the plains of Zarganash, waiting for my wards to power up. Waiting for my soul to be slowly pulled back and manifest in the world of the living once again. What I had Nãot taken into consideration was peace.
npc.flickering_soul.say_7: I recognized the extent of my folly and failure. I decided Nãot to return to the world of the living.
npc.flickering_soul.say_8: [PT] The only way I can get rid of them is to disperse them, to 'kill' them so to say. But they are tainted parts of myself and even going near them might endanger my sanity and stability. So all I can do is to ask you to do this daunting task.
npc.flickering_soul.say_9: I'm aware I have Não right to ask and I have little to offer as a payment, but I ask you Nãonetheless. Will you face my fettered vices and destroy them for me?

npc.garamond.say_1: Spells are very useful in combat - Nãot only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
npc.garamond.say_10: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce Monstros that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...
npc.garamond.say_11: [PT] Once you have reached level 8, you are ready to choose a vocation and go to the Tibian Mainland.
npc.garamond.say_12: [PT] Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. ...
npc.garamond.say_13: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to kNãow more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...
npc.garamond.say_14: [PT] I myself teach try-out spells for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin spells.
npc.garamond.say_15: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' Nãoises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...
npc.garamond.say_16: [PT] However, she's also a very apt healer and can give you advice on your choice of vocation.
npc.garamond.say_2: There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can Comprar with level 8 and on. ...
npc.garamond.say_3: [PT] Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
npc.garamond.say_4: Each vocation has its own individual spells that Nãone of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
npc.garamond.say_5: [PT] The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
npc.garamond.say_6: [PT] There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
npc.garamond.say_7: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and Missãos than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...
npc.garamond.say_8: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have eNãough Ouro! ...
npc.garamond.say_9: The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable kNãowledge of a spell to a Nãovice if they can pay the price.

npc.gerimor.kw_boogies_1: [PT] Boogies are a rather twisted kind of fae. Other than pixies, nymphs or fauns they favour underground caves and tunnels over forests or lush meadows. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_boogies_2: Only at night, they are roaming the surface, chasing other fae and visitors to Feyrist alike. They were once clumsy yet peaceful fae, but they are Nãow twisted and tainted by a mysterious, sinister force.
npc.gerimor.kw_cults_1: [PT] It doesn't seem that the cults share a common theme or object of reverence but there has to be some connection beyond being at the centre of culminations of disruptive power from beyond. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_cults_2: The connection is of second thought though. Connected or Nãot, they further the death of our world. That alone makes it imperative to dig those cults out and destroy their cores. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_cults_3: [PT] We won't be able to rout our each and any movement but if we manage to neutralize the worst, we gain some time and deny the enemy much of its leverage on the future of our world.
npc.gerimor.kw_dawn_1: Even we kNãow the individual that was somewhat of our funder, only as the wise man. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_dawn_2: [PT] He was the first to bring bright and dedicated minds together, to bring at least a little order and guidance into troubled and chaotic times. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_dawn_3: The order predates mankind and never bothered to give itself a name. Such assumptions of pretence and vanity have Não place in our mindset.
npc.gerimor.kw_direct_1: [PT] Sometimes it's necessary to do something about a situation that became threatening to the world itself. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_direct_2: It is gladly a rare occurrence and usually it is sufficient to somewhat offer a guiding hand to avert a course that would lead to more dire consequences. Nãonetheless sometimes we have to interfere.
npc.gerimor.kw_fae_1: [PT] The fae vary greatly in size and appearance. There are different kinds of fae like fauns, pixies, pookas, swan maidens, nymphs and boogies. Those mystical creatures are wielding power in magic and elementals. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_fae_2: [PT] Most of them are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in their secret realm. Sometimes they are called the 'children of dreams' or 'the dream born' because the fae are born from the mortals' dreams.
npc.gerimor.kw_fae_court_1: [PT] The fae vary greatly in size and appearance. There are different kinds of fae like fauns, pixies, pookas, swan maidens, nymphs and boogies. Those mystical creatures are wielding power in magic and elementals. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_fae_court_2: [PT] Most of them are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in their secret realm. Sometimes they are called the ,children of dreams' or ,the dream born' because the fae are born from the mortals' dreams.
npc.gerimor.kw_fauns_1: [PT] Fauns are half-human, half-beast nature spirits inhabiting the woods and mountains of Feyrist. They are a slightly roguish but cheerful folk, lovers of wine and dancing. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_fauns_2: [PT] Fauns show a youthful and graceful aspect but they are also brave and fearless when it comes to defend themselves. As Maelyrra told me, they emerge from mortals' dreams about celebrations, music and dancing. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_fauns_3: [PT] Lately, some fauns on Feyrist are tainted by the mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
npc.gerimor.kw_guidance_1: Most times we are silent watchers and keeper of kNãowledge that share what they have learned with each other. We are more concerned about kNãowledge and wisdom and power means little to us. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_guidance_2: [PT] To solve problems we usually try to convince the right people to do the right thing. We usually even lack the means for a more direct interference.
npc.gerimor.kw_maelyrra_1: [PT] She's the queen of a fae court. You can find her on a glade in the deep forest. It was queen Maelyrra who granted me permission to stay here in Feyrist. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_maelyrra_2: [PT] I promised to inform her about anything I find out about the abominable force that threatens this world.
npc.gerimor.kw_me_1: [PT] I'm a member of a circle of persons, that joined wisdom and resources for a common purpose. Let's say, we have an eye on the greater picture in the matters of our world. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_me_2: We are watching and evaluating what is happening in our world.	Trying to avert the worst and offering a Ajudaing hand where we deem it needed. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_me_3: We usually avoid to interfere directly in the affairs of the world and vain politics are Nãot our concern at all.
npc.gerimor.kw_nymphs_1: Nymphs are female nature spirits and usually take the form of beautiful, young maidens who love to dance and sing. They dwell in the hills and forests of Feyrist, often near lakes and streams and they can't die of old age Nãor illness. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_nymphs_2: [PT] They have a special, strong bond to the plants and animals of their domain and are very protective of Feyrist's flora and fauna. As Maelyrra told me, nymphs emerge from mortals' dreams about love.
npc.gerimor.kw_persons_1: [PT] Well, while I focus more on the matters of life, some of my peers have different approaches and emphasize other aspects of the world more in their observations. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_persons_2: [PT] Regardless we share a common goal of balance and harmony.
npc.gerimor.kw_pixies_1: [PT] Pixies are small nature spirits and mythical creatures inhabiting the forests and plains of Feyrist. They are generally benign, but at times, they may also display mischievous traits. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_pixies_2: [PT] Like most of the fae, pixies love dancing and are often gathering in larger groups to dance on secluded glades. Pixies love flowers, butterflies, shimmering beetles, gems and other colourful things. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_pixies_3: [PT] They also love the taste of honey, sweetened oat and ripe grapes. As Maelyrra told me, pixies emerge from mortals' dreams about friends and family.
npc.gerimor.kw_pookas_1: [PT] Pookas are nature spirits in animal form, looking like big hares with a faintly glittering fur. They are benign but mischievous, for sure with good reason regarded as the tricksters among the fae. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_pookas_2: Pookas love to play pranks on others, snitching and hiding things or telling made-up stories. They are capricious and fickle creatures. Pookas emerge from mortals' dreams about gems, treasures and Ouro. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_pookas_3: [PT] Lately, some pookas on Feyrist are tainted by a mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
npc.gerimor.kw_swan_maidens_1: [PT] Swan maidens are fae who can shapeshift from human form to swan form. The magical item allowing this transformation is a swan feather cloak, a garment with swan feathers attached. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_swan_maidens_2: [PT] Here on Feyrist it is always hard to tell whether a swan swimming on a lake is an ordinary animal or a swan maiden in her bird shape. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_swan_maidens_3: [PT] They protect the wilds of their secret realm from every intruder and live in small flocks along secluded lakeshores. As Maelyrra told me, swan maidens emerge from mortals' dreams about flying.
npc.gerimor.kw_works_1: [PT] We haven't completely figured out what our enemy exactly is. For one, this thing defies all laws of nature and comprehension, ...
npc.gerimor.kw_works_2: that understanding it is either impossible or twist a mind in ways that are Nãot meant to be. Also the Yalahari who figured out way too much about the thing, became tainted and changed by this kNãowledge ...
npc.gerimor.kw_works_3: And ultimately Nãot only fell and became his, they also provided the thing with something of their own, be it kNãowledge, understanding or even direction, purpose. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_works_4: In some way their tainted kNãowledge brought the unthinkable into a resemblance of existence. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_works_5: [PT] That is why we cant dabble too much in figuring this out and rather concentrate on our fight to severe its ties to our world.
npc.gerimor.kw_worst_1: [PT] We have located some of the worst culminations of otherworldly presence and our sources returned information about them with different results of success. ...
npc.gerimor.kw_worst_2: [PT] Some information I can provide you will be rather sparse and much is left to speculation but you should have at least some lead where to go and investigate.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_1: This place is a sanctuary of CruNãor and provides me with a opportunity of spiritual contemplation.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_2: [PT] We focus our interest on this we see as threatening for live and the laws of nature itself.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_3: We might Nãot be many but we are diverse. Our rather informal order came together in the dawn of time, when the wars of the gods ravaged the world.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_4: [PT] Interference comes in different forms. In this particular case there is sadly little time for subtlety and a more direct approach is necessary.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_5: [PT] The fae granted me permission to enter their hidden realm. As a druid I'm in close touch with nature so I could gain their trust. The nature spirits are inhabiting this peninsula for ages.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_6: [PT] Those cults have to be stopped by any means possible. These are desperate times and they demand desperate actions.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_7: Spare lives where you see it fit but the cults may Nãot be allowed to exist and disrupt the fabric of the world even more.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_8: [PT] The weakened fabric of our reality still repels the unnatural intruder. The cults provide the thing a hold and supply it with more power, even if we couldn't figure out yet, how this works at all.
npc.gerimor.stdmod_9: [PT] I have several missions available that deal with servering the ties of the corrupting influence on our world.

npc.gewen.stdmod_2: [PT] Never heard about a place like this.

npc.gewen.voice_1: Nãothing beats the feeling of flying with a carpet!

npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_left_1: Some of the relics are still left in this world. They are insignia of the snake god's power. We kNãow that you came for one of those insignia. ...
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_left_2: The Great Snake approves that you acquire its holy sceptre. We will Nãot Missãoion the wisdom of the god to hand this relic to one of the false-born.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_slumber_1: [PT] We were once the heigh priests of the Great Snake. We willingly left our mortal existence behind to become bound to this temple. ...
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_slumber_2: In this state we can serve the Great Snake in a more suitable way. You have to understand that it is an hoNãour and a privilege, Nãot a sacrifice.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_worthy_1: [PT] The Great Snake deserves that we try to use the best of our abilities and capabilities to serve it. Our existence is a test in this world corrupted by the egg stealers. ...
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.kw_worthy_2: [PT] Only when we overcome all obstacles cast into our way, we will become worthy to serve the Great Snake in all eternity.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_1: [PT] We are the {guardians}. We are all what is left from the glory of the past.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_10: [PT] There are many forms of corruption in this world. All of it is the work of the egg stealers who spread their taint. The creation hatched by the Great {Snake} was perfect without even the option of corruption.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_11: [PT] Creatures from beyond. Greedy and traitorous, they stole parts of the world and of life for themselves. They corrupted the world by their deceptions and stole our {birthright}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_12: [PT] We were overthrown by those of who we vainly thought we could use for our advantage, even though we knew about the foulness of the false-born.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_13: Everything that lacks scales is Não true litter of the Great Snake. They are the corrupted kin of the egg stealers.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_14: [PT] Such concepts are of little consequence for the dead.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_15: [PT] They are a manifestation of the snake god's power. They are its avatars in some way.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_16: [PT] We are the true-born. We are the children of the snake. But as children we have yet much to learn. One day we might take our rightful place in creation, but only if we prove {worthy}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_17: [PT] They are the false-born. They hatched from foul eggs - poisoned by the egg stealers. They are numerous and like a plague for the world.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_18: [PT] This was once the centre of power of our religion. From here we ruled Tiquanda in the name of the snake god.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_19: We were Nãot aware of aNãother civilisation that was left. Only recently the awareness of the Great Snake touched us in our slumber and we learnt through visions of its other children.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_2: [PT] We are the keepers of this old temple and the guardians of its sacred {secrets}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_3: [PT] We are keepers of the {lore} of the Great {Snake} and we guard some of its {relics}.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_4: The lore of the Great {Snake} is contorted like a snake. Although we feel you are touched by the snake's essence, you are Nãot ready yet to receive the blessing of the deeper wisdom.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_5: [PT] Once the powerful relics of the Great {Snake} were abundant. Most got lost to the ravages of time and our enemies. What is {left} is all the more precious.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_6: [PT] We are the guardians. We are all what is left from the glory of the past.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_7: [PT] What you call Banuta was once a centre of our civilisation and culture. We gave those {apes} so much, but they wanted more. In the end, the Great {Snake} used them as a tool to teach our people a painful but necessary lesson.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_8: In their vanity our descendants thought they could use those false-born as servants. They paid a terrible price. Their downfall might only be temporary though if we can {redeem} our race in the eSim of the snake god.
npc.ghost_of_a_priest.stdmod_9: [PT] Dragons are one of the greatest creations of the Great {Snake}. Yet, they are still distanced from the Great {Snake} and susceptible for {corruption} and the lies of the egg stealers.

npc.gnomus.kw_base_1: GNãomish supplies and ingenuity have Ajudaed to establish and fortify this outpost. ...
npc.gnomus.kw_base_2: Our kNãowledge of the enemy and it's tactics would be of more use if the dwarves would listen to us somewhat more. But gNãomes have learned to live with the imperfection of the other races.
npc.gnomus.kw_efforts_1: [PT] Our surveys of the area showed us some spikes in heat and seismic activity at very specific places. ...
npc.gnomus.kw_efforts_2: We conclude this is Não coincidence and the enemy is using devices to pump up the lava to flood the area. We have seen it before and had to retreat each time. ...
npc.gnomus.kw_efforts_3: [PT] This time though we might have a counter prepared - given me manage to pierce their defences.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_1: If you're willing to Ajuda us, we could need an escort for arriving {ordnance}, Ajuda with {charting} the cave system and someone needs to get some heat {measurements} fast.
npc.gnomus.stdmod_3: I'm the main gNãomish contact for this base. I coordinate our efforts with those of the dwarves to ensure everything is running smoothly.

npc.halvar.stdmod_3: There are three difficulties: Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord. On each challenge you will be confronted with ten Monstros increasing in strength.

npc.henricus.stdmod_1: [PT] It's a shame that only a few paladins still use their abilities to further the cause of the gods of good. Too many paladins have become selfish and greedy.
npc.henricus.stdmod_10: Drefia used to be a city of sin and heresy, just like Carlin Nãowadays. One day, the gods decided to destroy this town and to erase all evil there.
npc.henricus.stdmod_11: [PT] Darashia is a godless town full of mislead fools. One day, it will surely share the fate of its sister town Drefia.
npc.henricus.stdmod_12: [PT] Demons exist in many different shapes and levels of power. In general, they are servants of the dark gods and command great powers of destruction.
npc.henricus.stdmod_13: [PT] Carlin is a city of sin and heresy. After the reunion of Carlin with the kingdom, the inquisition will have much work to purify the city and its inhabitants.
npc.henricus.stdmod_14: We can see his evil influence almost everywhere. Keep your eSim open or the dark one will lead you on the wrong way and destroy you.
npc.henricus.stdmod_15: The church of CruNãor works closely together with the druid guild. This makes a cooperation sometimes difficult.
npc.henricus.stdmod_16: [PT] We owe to the gods of good our creation and continuing existence. If it weren't for them, we would surely fall prey to the minions of the vile and dark gods.
npc.henricus.stdmod_17: [PT] The churches of the gods united to fight heresy and dark magic. They are the shield of the true believers, while the inquisition is the sword that fights all enemies of virtuousness.
npc.henricus.stdmod_18: The churches of the gods entrusted me with the eNãormous and responsible task to lead the inquisition. I leave the field work to inquisitors who I recruit from fitting people that cross my way.
npc.henricus.stdmod_19: [PT] Belive on the gods and they will show you the path.
npc.henricus.stdmod_2: Nãowadays, most knights seem to have forgotten the Nãoble cause to which all knights were bound in the past. Only a few have remained pious, serve the gods and follow their teachings.
npc.henricus.stdmod_20: [PT] By edict of the churches I'm the Lord Inquisitor.
npc.henricus.stdmod_3: [PT] Those who wield great power have to resist great temptations. We have the burden to eliminate all those who give in to the temptations.
npc.henricus.stdmod_4: [PT] The druids here still follow the old rules. Sadly, the druids of Carlin have left the right path in the last years.
npc.henricus.stdmod_5: [PT] The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_6: [PT] The dwarfs are allied with Thais but follow their own obscure religion. Although dwarfs keep mostly to themselves, we have to observe this alliance closely.
npc.henricus.stdmod_7: [PT] Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_8: [PT] Those elves are hardly any more civilised than orcs. They can become a threat to mankind at any time.
npc.henricus.stdmod_9: VeNãore is somewhat difficult to handle. The merchants have a close eye on our activities in their city and our authority is limited there. However, we will use all of our influence to prevent a second Carlin.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_1: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| Ouro, child?

npc.humphrey.stdmod_6: [PT] Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.
npc.humphrey.stdmod_7: [PT] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

npc.inigo.say_1: It seems to emanate a magical call or pulse that draws all sorts of creatures to it - Não offense meant. When we first found it, we were flabbergasted - we thought maybe a mad sorcerer had built it, or a cult, to summon something evil. ...
npc.inigo.say_10: Fighting is essential in Tibia, and though Dawnport is quite safe in comparison to the mainland, be careful Nãot to die, as {dying} HURTS. ...
npc.inigo.say_11: If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_12: There are many dangers in {Tibia}. You may have to defend yourself Nãot only against {Monstros}, but if {PvP} is allowed, against other {Jogadors}, too. ...
npc.inigo.say_13: [PT] To attack, click on your chosen target in the battle list. A red frame will show you which target you are currently attacking. ...
npc.inigo.say_14: [PT] To automatically follow your target, click on 'Chase Opponent' in your combat controls - the top left button. ...
npc.inigo.say_15: [PT] You can also define your attack and defense mode, by selecting {offensive}, {balanced} or {defensive} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_16: Depending on the world you chose in {Tibia}, {Jogadors} may attack you at all times or only if you consent. ...
npc.inigo.say_17: On an Optional PvP world, PvP is only possible if both Jogadors consent to it; but on Open PvP or Hardcore PvP worlds, any Jogador may always attack you, so be watchful. ...
npc.inigo.say_18: A brown frame around a Jogador indicates he or she is in a PvP situation. A {skull} next to a Jogador name means he or she attacked or killed aNãother Jogador. ...
npc.inigo.say_19: Here on {Dawnport}, PvP is Nãot allowed inside the outpost, and Nãot possible until you have reached level 8 at least. If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_2: But we didn't find any conclusive hints. {Menesto} and a few others volunteered to guard the portal from the {Monstros} of this isle. You say you came through it from your world! Astounding. ...
npc.inigo.say_20: To chat with other Jogadors, you can click on one of the chat channels and see who is posting in there. ...
npc.inigo.say_21: If you want to message a specific Jogador, right-click on his or her name and select 'Message to <Jogador name>'. This will open up a chat channel where you can type in your message to him or her.
npc.inigo.say_22: NPC means someone like me or {Hamish} or {Coltrayne}, for example. You can easily discern us from {Jogadors} like you, because there is a speech bubble next to our {name}. ...
npc.inigo.say_23: We all have our different ways, but Nãormally, addressing an NPC with 'hi' or 'Olá' will open a conversation. ...
npc.inigo.say_24: Some NPCs will have secret words that they react to that are Nãot highlighted in their conversation. In that case, you need to type in your Missãoion. ...
npc.inigo.say_25: [PT] To do so, open the NPC Chat Channel and click on the empty space below the NPCs dialogue, and start typing. ...
npc.inigo.say_26: You can try this out by asking an NPC about their {job}, as this is a keyword most will react to. If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_27: [PT] Every vocation has specific spells that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on spells, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...
npc.inigo.say_28: [PT] As an adventurer in training, you have a few spells at your disposal at the beginning, but more will become available as you progress. ...
npc.inigo.say_29: [PT] Once you're level 8, new spells become available upstairs at the spell trainers {Garamond} and {Tybald}. They can tell you more.
npc.inigo.say_3: You couldn't have chosen a better time. We really need Ajuda against the Monstros that swarm this island, and the whole world of {Tibia}. If you're unsure on how to {Ajuda} exactly, I can give you directions.
npc.inigo.say_30: [PT] Second best thing to a rope - a shovel will reveal secret entrances buried under loose stone piles, or under sand, or earth... you will see! ...
npc.inigo.say_31: Shovels can be bought at {Richard}'s, like the other equipment, or food. If you don't have the money yet, go out and kill some {Monstros} outside - and maybe you'll even find a shovel, who kNãows!
npc.inigo.say_32: We found the island following a strange glow we saw at night, close before dawn. We were looking for a source of unkNãown, powerful magic, and it seemed that this island was its source. ...
npc.inigo.say_33: When we arrived, we found goblins, miNãotaurs, trolls and undead warring on this island. We wondered why. Then they seemed to reach an agreement, and settled down in the caves. We decided to investigate. ...
npc.inigo.say_34: That is when we found the strange crystal {portal}, through which you came. Perhaps this is why the {Monstros} battle, but won't leave. ...
npc.inigo.say_35: It certainly is a place of power, so {Menesto}'s group was sent down to guard it. However, we are but few, so we need every Ajuda we can get to defend and maintain the outpost on this isle. ...
npc.inigo.say_36: That is why we need your Ajuda - choose the vocation that suits you, take up its arms and Ajuda us defend this place against the evil that wants to claim it! If you need any Ajuda in how to do these things, ask me.
npc.inigo.say_37: The mainland harbours the most ancient cities of {Tibia}, and many dangers and adventures as well. When you have Ajudaed us defend {Dawnport}, and learned eNãough of the ways of Tibia to reach level 8 at least, you should leave for the mainland. ...
npc.inigo.say_38: [PT] There you can continue to battle evil - and believe me, there is much of that in our world, alas. <sigh> ...
npc.inigo.say_39: Premium adventurers can also sail to the many islands that surround the mainland, which offer many more dangers and mysteries to be explored; and you can do Missãos to ride mounts, and dress in a variety of new outfits.
npc.inigo.say_4: [PT] Hasn't been with us for very long. Very interested in all things mystical, so Menesto was sent down to guard the strange crystal {portal} we found here. ...
npc.inigo.say_40: [PT] Go through one of the open gates on this floor and you will be equipped with training weapons and {spells} of a specific vocation. ...
npc.inigo.say_41: [PT] There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {druid}, {paladin} and {sorcerer}. Each one has its unique abilities, strengths and weaknesses. Just try them out to see which one suits you best. ...
npc.inigo.say_42: We need your Ajuda in our battle. Fight {Monstros} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have Nãot only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...
npc.inigo.say_43: [PT] Once you reached level 8 or more, you have to choose one vocation as your definite vocation before you can leave for the Tibian {mainland}, where more dangers await you. ...
npc.inigo.say_44: To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'Ajuda' to her. ...
npc.inigo.say_45: If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_46: [PT] A vocation is your profession and chosen destiny, rolled into one. There are four vocations in {Tibia}: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each vocation has its unique special abilities with which to fight evil. ...
npc.inigo.say_47: You need to choose your vocation before you can leave {Dawnport} to go to the {Mainland}. But first, you have to gain eNãough experience to reach level 8 in order to do so. ...
npc.inigo.say_48: [PT] Once you've reached level 8 and want to choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the temple. She can also heal you if you are hurt or poisoned. ...
npc.inigo.say_49: If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_5: ... But of course, you met him. ... So it really is a portal, and you came through it from aNãother plane of existence! I never quite believed the tales of old, Nãot really. But Nãow... it's wonderful, truly wonderful. ...
npc.inigo.say_50: [PT] I can give you directions how to {play}, some basic survival and {combat} tips, or explain {PvP}, ...
npc.inigo.say_51: I can also tell you how to talk with other {Jogadors} or {NPC}s, or can inform you about {Missãoing} or {spells}. ...
npc.inigo.say_52: I also have a list of small {hints} if you prefer that, and can tell you something of the {people} here. Just tell me what you want to kNãow. ...
npc.inigo.say_53: Oh, but first that Ajuda I mentioned - you should get yourself a {shovel}, friend. It will come in handy when you set about finding secret entrances to dungeons or hidden treasures - many useful things lie hidden beneath earth, sand or stones!
npc.inigo.say_54: Offensive {fighting} means you deal harder attacks, but have a weaker defense. Magical damage you deal is Nãot affected by this. ...
npc.inigo.say_55: You should switch to offensive only if you want to finish off a Monstro quickly and are sure you can survive its harder attacks. I can also tell you something about {balanced} and {defensive} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_56: Balanced {fighting} balances out your attack strength as well as your defense strength. Magical damage you deal is Nãot affected by this. ...
npc.inigo.say_57: [PT] I can also tell you something about {offensive} and {defensive} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_58: Defensive {fighting} increases your defense but reduces your attack strength. The magical damage you deal is Nãot affected by this. ...
npc.inigo.say_59: [PT] I can also tell you something about {offensive} and {balanced} fighting.
npc.inigo.say_6: Well, if you have any Missãoions as to THIS plane of existence, which we call {Tibia}, just ask me. I can give directions, {hints}, you name it. <winks at you>
npc.inigo.say_60: A white skull means that this Jogador attacked and maybe killed aNãother Jogador without justification. ...
npc.inigo.say_61: A red skull means someone has killed many other {Jogadors}, while a black skull depicts someone on a serious killing spree - so watch out!
npc.inigo.say_62: Some sort of misguided genius, I think. Brilliant with potions and runes, but couldn't get on with his master or with the other students. Ran away and set up his own little lab, Vendering to travellers along the road. ...
npc.inigo.say_63: [PT] Was robbed and left for dead by some plunderers, when Morris found him. {Morris} patched him up and said he could use him, so Hamish came here. If you need a wand, rune or potion, Hamish's your man.
npc.inigo.say_64: Coltrayne doesn't say much about himself. What I gathered from the 15 years I've kNãown him is that he was raised by a blacksmith as a foundling. ...
npc.inigo.say_65: [PT] When a fire destroyed his foster family's home, he took up an unsteady life, always wandering around. Then he met {Morris} and decided to go adventuring with him.
npc.inigo.say_66: Ah, there are lots of stories about Morris. Likes to insist on the 'Mr'. Nãobody kNãows his first name, and the telling goes that he has gambled with a demon and lost his first name to him. ...
npc.inigo.say_67: [PT] The demon is said to have set Morris free so he can reclaim him at the end of his life, meanwhile having fun watching Morris struggle through hardship and adventures. ...
npc.inigo.say_68: Anyway. One way or aNãother, Morris picked us all up and gathered us here. Nãot sure that sending others on missions is really all it's about for him, but if you're looking for a Missão, go ask Morris for one.
npc.inigo.say_69: Nãot your level, but your skill with your weapon determines how much damage you make. With a distance weapon like a bow, you {train} your distance {fighting} skill, with a sword your sword fighting, etc. ...
npc.inigo.say_7: Our world {Tibia} is swarmed by many dangerous {Monstros}, so {fighting} is something you will have to learn and master quickly. You can fight as a {sorcerer}, druid, {paladin} or {knight}. ...
npc.inigo.say_70: Druids and sorcerers train their magic level by using their mana through {spells} and runes. Their wand or rod damage is Nãot affected by their magic level. If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_71: [PT] You should never leave without a rope. NEVER. A rope can save your life. I once fell down into a poison spider lair - without a rope, I wouldn't be standing here today! ...
npc.inigo.say_72: You can Comprar a rope over at {Richard}'s shop. If you don't have the money, kill and loot a few {Monstros} - maybe one of them even has a rope with it, that sort of thing happens.
npc.inigo.say_73: Our local healer. Don't kNãow why that druid girl decided she wanted the unsteady life of an adventurer, but she's quite hardy, to tell the truth. I once saw her confront a polar bear.... but I'm getting carried away. ...
npc.inigo.say_74: If you need healing, go see her. Oressa can also Ajuda you decide if you want to choose your vocation to leave for the {Mainland}.
npc.inigo.say_75: [PT] When you die, you will be resurrected in the temple of the city you chose as your home. Temple {NPC}s, like {Oressa} here on {Dawnport}, can heal you if you're wounded or poisoned. Some special temple NPCs can also {bless} you. ...
npc.inigo.say_76: [PT] To be fully blessed, you should start the Pilgrimage of Ashes at a local guide in the harbour once you have reached the {mainland}.
npc.inigo.say_77: Don't be deceived by its sweet looks - {Tibia} is a rough world. If you die, you will lose skill and experience and perhaps even some items, and other {Jogadors} can rob your corpse. ...
npc.inigo.say_78: On the {Mainland}, you can Comprar blessings from {temple} {NPC}s to prevent item loss, but you will always lose some {skills} and experience, so be careful. ...
npc.inigo.say_79: [PT] Always have a {rope} with you, for a start. A rope is essential.
npc.inigo.say_8: We need your Ajuda in keeping the Monstros at bay - walk out of one of the four gates here, and you will receive one of the four {vocations} and its gear to try out and fight Monstros. ...
npc.inigo.say_80: [PT] Every vocation has specific {spells} that can only be used if you have that vocation. Sorcerers and druids of course rely heavily on spells, while knights only have a few at their disposal. ...
npc.inigo.say_81: [PT] As an adventurer in training, you have a few spells at your disposal at the beginning, but more will become available as you progress. ...
npc.inigo.say_82: [PT] Once you're level 8, new spells become available upstairs at the spell trainers {Garamond} and {Tybald}. They can tell you more.

npc.inigo.say_85: We need your Ajuda in our battle. Fight {Monstros} to gain experience and better {skills}, until you reach level 8 at least. Make sure you always have Nãot only a weapon, but a {rope} with you, as well! ...
npc.inigo.say_86: [PT] Once you reached level 8 or more, you have to choose one vocation as your definite vocation before you can leave for the Tibian {mainland}, where more dangers await you. ...
npc.inigo.say_87: To choose your definite vocation, talk to {Oressa} downstairs in the {temple}. She can also heal you if you are severely wounded or poisoned - just say 'heal' or 'Ajuda' to her. ...
npc.inigo.say_88: If you have any other Missãoions, tell me.
npc.inigo.say_89: [PT] The blessings of the gods will protect you from item loss and alleviate the skill and experience loss when you die. But you will have to undertake the Pilgrimage of Ashes on the {mainland} to get the blessings. ...
npc.inigo.say_9: {Dawnport} is just a small, but dangerous island. You will have to reach level 8 at least and choose your definite vocation before you can leave for the {mainland}. To reach level 8, you will have to fight some Monstros in order to progress. ...
npc.inigo.say_90: If you die in a fight from a Monstro's attack, your blessings will be lost, and you will have to get them again. ...
npc.inigo.say_91: [PT] There is also a blessing that will protect you specifically from losses in a {PvP} fight. This blessing you will need to get again when you have been killed in a PvP fight. ...
npc.inigo.say_92: Here on {Dawnport}, you are protected from losses in a PvP fight by the Adventurer's Blessing - unless you attack aNãother Jogador. If you attack aNãother Jogador or reach level 20, you will lose this blessing.
npc.inigo.say_93: Careful, careful, it's a one-way ticket only! You can never come back here if you leave Nãow, and you will loso all your Dawnport equipment and products! ...
npc.inigo.say_94: [PT] Are you {SURE} you want to {LEAVE} Dawnport for ROOKGAARD?

npc.iskan.kw_bonelords_1: [PT] I'll tell you something. I have seen such a creature once, far on the ice to the east. It was the coldest winter I can remember and the chakoyas were roaming the ice almost everywhere. ...
npc.iskan.kw_bonelords_2: [PT] To evade them, me and the boys had to walk a long way to a spot where the ice was treacherous and thin. ...
npc.iskan.kw_bonelords_3: And there I've seen such a creature. The boys went almost mad and I turned my sled immediately. Não idea how we made it home. True story.

npc.ser_tybald.array_1:
Spells are very useful in combat - Nãot only for mages, though of course we particularly \z

There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. \z
