npc.ser_tybald.say_1: Spells are very useful in combat - Nãot only for mages, though of course we particularly rely on them for much of our damage output. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_10: Ah, the beauty of our world! It is vast and extraordinarily diverse. Strange islands, beautiful cities and fierce Monstros that roam the wildernesses. Mysteries, adventures, danger around every corner. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_11: [PT] Once you have reached level 8, you are ready to choose a vocation and go to the Tibian Mainland.
npc.ser_tybald.say_12: [PT] Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_13: There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to kNãow more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_14: [PT] I myself teach try-out spells for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin spells.
npc.ser_tybald.say_15: A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' Nãoises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_16: [PT] However, she's also a very apt healer and can give you advice on your choice of vocation.
npc.ser_tybald.say_2: There's a broad variety of what spells can do, as you will see as you progress further. The next spells you can Comprar with level 8 and on. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_3: [PT] Some attack spells can be directed at a single target while others affect an area, having an effect either over time or instantaneous. Even other spells protect you, or can be used to create runes. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_4: Each vocation has its own individual spells that Nãone of the other vocations can use. You can only learn spells at a spell trainer of your vocation. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_5: [PT] The spells here on Dawnport are for trying out only, and you will forget them once you choose your definite vocation and leave for the Mainland. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_6: [PT] There, you can go to a spell teacher in a city to permanently learn a spell.
npc.ser_tybald.say_7: The Mainland offers many more adventures, dangers and Missãos than this small isle, and also has spell teachers where you can permanently learn a spell for your vocation. ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_8: Once you reach level 8 you may choose your definite vocation and leave for Main. Go to a city and seek out the spell trainer of your vocation to learn a spell. And make sure you have eNãough Ouro! ...
npc.ser_tybald.say_9: The art of spell teaching is complex and dangerous, and we will only impart our valuable kNãowledge of a spell to a Nãovice if they can pay the price.

npc.seymour.stdmod_32: [PT] Well, the {king} doesn't send troops anymore, the {academy} is dreadfully low on money, and the end of the world is pretty nigh. Apart from that I'm reasonably fine, I suppose.
npc.seymour.stdmod_33: Most of the citizens here are {merchants}. You can give me the name of any Nãon-Jogador character and I will tell you something about him or her.
npc.seymour.stdmod_34: Merchants Comprar and Vender goods. Just ask them for a {Comércio} to see what they offer or Comprar from you.
npc.seymour.stdmod_35: Trolls are quite nasty Monstros which you shouldn't face before level 3 or 4 depending on your {equipment}. Ask the bridge {guards} for their locations!
npc.seymour.stdmod_36: The guards {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus} protect our village from {Monstros} trying to enter. They also mark useful {dungeon} locations on your map.
npc.seymour.stdmod_37: [PT] There are four vocations: {knights}, {paladins}, {sorcerers} and {druids}. You can choose your vocation once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_38: [PT] Sorcerers are talented elemental magicians. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_39: [PT] Knights are strong melee fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_4: Gain some kNãowledge in the academy!
npc.seymour.stdmod_40: [PT] Druids are nature magic users and great healers. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_41: [PT] Paladins are swift distance fighters. You will learn all about them once you are level 8 and reached the Island of {Destiny}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_42: We have a {weapon} and an {armor} shop south of the academy. {Equipment} such as {ropes} are sold to the Nãorth-west. {Potions} can be bought to the south. And then there are the {farms}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_43: [PT] The world of Tibia is very large with tons of places to explore. Vast deserts, Caribbean islands, deep jungles, green meadows and jagged mountains await you!
npc.seymour.stdmod_44: The temple is the place to go when you are very low on {health} or poisoned. Ask {Cipfried} for a heal - he usually Nãotices emergencies by himself.
npc.seymour.stdmod_45: [PT] Your current health is shown by the red bar on the right side. {Death} awaits you if it goes down to zero.
npc.seymour.stdmod_46: [PT] Dying in Tibia is painful, so try to avoid it. You will lose part of your {experience} points and also equipment. Make sure your {health} always stays up!
npc.seymour.stdmod_47: You gain experience when fighting {Monstros}. You can take a look at your skill window to check your progress.
npc.seymour.stdmod_48: Good Monstros to start hunting are {rats}. They live in the {sewers} below the village.
npc.seymour.stdmod_49: [PT] One entrance to the sewers is south of this {academy}. Look for a sewer grate, then use it to climb down.
npc.seymour.stdmod_5: Olá, |JogadorNAME|. Bem-vindo to the Academy of Rookgaard. May I sign you up as a {student}?
npc.seymour.stdmod_50: [PT] The academy is the building you are standing in. We have a {library}, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_51: [PT] There are many books in the bookcases around you, unless some naughty kids stole them again. Read them for more and detailed information.
npc.seymour.stdmod_52: [PT] Don't go hunting without proper equipment. You need at least a suitable {weapon}, {armor}, {shield}, {rope} and {shovel}. A {torch} is also good as well as {legs}, a {helmet} and {shoes}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_53: Make money by killing {Monstros} and picking up their {loot}. You can Vender many of the things they carry.
npc.seymour.stdmod_54: Once a Monstro is dead, you can select 'Open' on the {corpse} to check what's inside. Sometimes they carry {money} or other items which you can Vender to {merchants}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_55: You can even Vender some corpses! For example, you can Vender fresh dead rats to {Tom} the tanner or me. He also Comprars other dead creatures, just ask him for a {Comércio}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_56: You definitely need a rope to progress in dungeons, else you might end up stuck. Comprar one from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_57: A shovel is needed to dig some {dungeon} entrances open. 'Use' it on a loose stone pile to make a hole large eNãough to enter.
npc.seymour.stdmod_58: You should Nãot descend into dungeons without proper {equipment}. Once you are all prepared, ask the bridge {guards} for suitable {Monstros}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_59: A torch will provide you with light in dark {dungeons}. 'Use' it to light it. You can Comprar them from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_60: Well, I could give you valuable {lessons} or some general {hints} about the game, or a small {Missão} if you're interested.
npc.seymour.stdmod_61: The starter armor, a coat, does Nãot protect you well. First of all, earn some money and try to get a sturdy leather armor from {Dixi}'s  or {Lee'Delle}'s shop. Simply ask for a {Comércio}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_65: Leather boots are basic shoes which will protect you well. You can either Comprar them from {Dixi} and {Lee'Delle}, or, once you are strong eNãough, {loot} them from {trolls}.

npc.seymour.stdmod_78: You have to fight {Monstros} to train your {skills} and {level}. If you lose {health}, eat {food} to regain it or use a {potion}.
npc.seymour.stdmod_79: The more you fight with a weapon, the better will be your skill handling this weapon. Don't worry about that right Nãow though, this will become important once you have a {vocation}.
